summaries.Romania: Romania faces an energy crisis with no timeline for reopening Cernavodă nuclear plant and rising electricity prices, while education systems show alarming decline with 48% of students failing to meet basic reading levels. Political turmoil continues as the president prepares a third prime minister nomination amid governance challenges.
summaries.Healthcare: AstraZeneca's experimental COPD treatment shows strong late-stage results positioning it competitively in the market, while a new pancreatic cancer drug approval faces administrative barriers delaying patient access. AI adoption accelerates in healthcare but readiness remains inconsistent across organizations.
summaries.Tech: Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' event launches the iPhone Ultra foldable and iPhone 18 Pro line this week amid rising memory costs pressuring prices, while competitors like Xiaomi and Samsung release competing foldables. Major AI developments continue with Mistral's €3B funding and advances in agentic AI systems.

items.title: The real reason your phone is getting more expensive
items.snippet: When Apple debuts the next generation of iPhones this week, they're likely to come with an unwanted change: a higher price tag. items.line: Rising memory chip costs are forcing iPhone price increases across the industry, signaling persistent supply-chain pressures with no near-term resolution in sight.
